title: The Sales Rep selector is read-only when the Work Order status is Invoiced or Paid
custom_preconds: 1. One Work Order is in "Invoiced" status and one is in "Paid" status (drive throwaway ZZAUTOTEST WOs into these states if needed).
custom_steps:
1. Open the Invoiced WO and try to change the Sales Rep field.
2. Open the Paid WO and try the same.
custom_expected:
1. On the Invoiced WO the Sales Rep selector is read-only (non-interactive) — the assignment cannot be changed.
2. On the Paid WO the selector is also read-only.
